content_of_post_to_answer: How can I maintain my mental health during a stressful job transition that’s facing unexpected delays?
answer: A delayed job transition is stressful because uncertainty consumes more energy than hard work itself. The hidden challenge is treating a temporary pause as a verdict on your future. Build small routines that remain under your control while plans change. I explore this pattern of uncertainty and resilience in more detail on my profile, if it helps. A delay is a situation to manage, not an identity to absorb.
